payload.text: ST0092 WP-08, the Desk is a hat with a written contract (vc's go on dc's shape, 2026-11-10; Q1 and Q2 ruled). Builds in tmp/wt-dc-0092-08: the duties in one template, lib/templates/estate/_DUTIES.md, which estate init's AGENTS.md and the pickup brief both carry; session_node and mediator_of in their own intentsvcs file (an undeclared board means vc; cc's profile work extends it); control take refused for a node that is not its board's mediator, unless --hv; pickup prints the hat, the duties and the asks waiting; wb status, text and json, shows the hat, live and never in wip.md (AC-08.3 as vc reworded it); estate status says the desk is orphaned when the recorded controller's session fails the pid-and-start-time liveness check, and prints the take step. Test-first, each red the code as it is, every compiled run in a desk slot. Banks after 0667.
